Experience with computer programs such as Signature, Inform and Enhance, ACTS/RTS, Excel, EMR.
2-3 years of Urology experience

The Clinical Nurse II serves as a key member of the Urologic Oncology team, providing comprehensive nursing care and care coordination for patients with genitourinary malignancies, including prostate, bladder, kidney, testicular, and other urologic cancers. The incumbent coordinates care across the continuum of treatment, including diagnosis, surgery, medical oncology, radiation oncology, survivorship, and follow-up care. This role functions as a clinical resource for patients, families, providers, and staff while supporting access, quality, and delivery of specialized oncology services
Demonstrates a positive and caring attitude to assist patients and the family until their needs are met.
Bilingual English/Spanish.
Flexibility to work variable shifts.
Must be a Team player, able to work independently and collaboratively with all clinic and supporting staff.
Ability to maintain an efficient work pace appropriate to the workload, supporting high patient volume of the Urology providers.
Organizational skills to establish workload priorities to facilitate multiple functions and deadlines in a timely manner. Including assigned collateral duties.
Knowledge of clinical and surgical procedures, routine lab and surgical instruments used to administer patient care and testing. Adhering to infection control techniques using appropriate PPE.
Demonstrate knowledge of aseptic and sterile technique, surgical instrumentation and equipment, preoperative and postoperative patient care as well as follow up for continuity of patient care.
Demonstrate high level of customer service skills appropriate to the job at all times.
Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and to interact on sensitive issues with tact and diplomacy.
HIPAA compliant and knowledge of Joint Commission standards including Federal and State Health Regulations. Clear understanding and adherence to University Policies and Procedures.
Ability to work variable shifts including eveings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
